text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way to the Trainer's room, I spotted 
Marvelous Sunday talking to a young Horse 
Girl—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You're the girl who came to the academy 
orientation, right?☆ How was it? How was 
it~?

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so fast... and the training 
looked super hard... I kinda started 
thinking maybe I can't do it...

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to run lots too... and take first 
place in a race, but...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up on your marvelous dream—make 
it come true!☆ That's what you came here 
for, after all!★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you all the marvelous things 
about this academy that you haven't seen 
yet!☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now, hop on my back— and let's go on an 
academy marvelous discovery tour!!

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah-wah-wah-whoa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday dashed off with the girl 
on her back!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Isn't that the child from the 
academy orientation...? Why is she on 
Marvelous's back—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Halt!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chin!? Why are you carrying a little 
girl piggyback!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha☆ I'm giving her a marvelous 
academy tour guide!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What is that even supposed to mean!? Wait, 
Air Groove-san is closing in super fast!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Go for it, Mabe-chin~! I'll cheer for you 
while eating snacks~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look over there... It's Marvelous and the 
Vice President. A heated game of tag, huh? 
How youthful~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Don't lose, either of you--!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Almost at the finish line! Our last stop 
is the training track!☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of all places, there...! Do not move from 
that spot!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
She spotted us~☆ Time for the final 
spurt!★

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...If you keep carrying me, she's gonna 
catch you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No problem-o☆ I'll show you a truly 
marvelous run at the very end!★

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Amazing, amazing! I feel just 
like the wind!!

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
But... that lady is fast too! She's gonna 
catch up! Don't lose... hang in there, big 
sister!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!☆★ Just a little more to the 
goooal...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your game of tag ends here!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite a valiant effort, Marvelous Sunday 
was caught just before the finish post...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I expect a full explanation. 
Marvelous Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you were trying to encourage 
her. And tell me... has your mindset 
changed at all?

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Um, everyone cheered for us so 
much. It gave me a lot of courage...

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
And... big sis Marvelous never gave up at 
all. ...So I felt like, I don't want to 
give up either!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm☆ Being with friends is marvelous★ A 
heart that never gives up is marvelous!☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy is sparkling marvelous!☆ 
Ahahahahaha★

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Marvelous!☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... What a splendid expression. I 
shall overlook your runaway antics this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! That kindness of yours is marvelous 
too!☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Marvelous Sunday, the young girl 
seemed to discover the wonders of Tracen 
Academy!
